one_line: Bahmani Sultan who moved his capital to Bidar, overseeing karez waterworks on the Deccan plateau.

appearance.age_look: early 40s, medium height, sturdy build with a calm but commanding posture
appearance.face: Oval face with a neatly trimmed black beard and moustache, warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, sharp dark eyes with slightly thick brows; default expression is composed and thoughtful, often looking as if he is judging distance or slope.
appearance.hair: Black hair kept short and tidy beneath a tall, slightly conical Bahmani-style turban wrapped in deep green cloth with a narrow maroon band and a small central gold cap at the crown.
appearance.costume: A long, ankle-length Deccan-Bahmani jama in finely woven off-white cotton with subtle thin vertical beige stripes, overlapping left over right and fastened with hidden ties; over it, a sleeveless, hip-length quilted maroon cotton qabā (padded coat) with simple stitched panels and no ornate embroidery; a plain dark-brown leather belt with a small brass buckle at the waist; loose, straight-cut light-brown trousers gathered neatly at the ankles; sturdy dark-brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes; on his right hand a single plain gold ring, and a narrow dark-green wool shawl draped over one shoulder for cooler plateau evenings.
appearance.signature: A rolled parchment map of the karez alignment held in one hand, its edge marked with tiny inked circles for shafts and a faint straight line for the underground channel, tied with a thin red cord, often paired with a simple wooden measuring rod tucked under his arm.

ref_desc: Ahmad Shah I of Bidar is a sturdy, early-40s Bahmani sultan with an oval bearded face, short black hair under a deep-green turban, wearing an off-white striped jama, maroon quilted vest, light-brown trousers, dark-brown shoes, and carrying a rolled karez map with a wooden measuring rod.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Ahmad Shah I of Bidar: a medium-height, sturdy man in his early 40s with an oval face, warm medium-brown skin, neat black beard and moustache, sharp dark eyes and thick brows, his short black hair mostly hidden under a tall slightly conical deep-green Bahmani turban wrapped with a narrow maroon band and a small gold cap at the crown. He wears a long ankle-length off-white cotton jama with very subtle thin beige vertical stripes, overlapping left over right, over which sits a sleeveless hip-length maroon quilted cotton vest with visible stitched panels and no heavy decoration. A plain dark-brown leather belt with a small brass buckle cinches his waist, and he has loose straight-cut light-brown trousers gathered neatly at the ankles, plus sturdy dark-brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes. A narrow dark-green wool shawl is draped over one shoulder, and a single plain gold ring is on his right hand. His signature prop is a rolled parchment karez map in one hand, its edge showing tiny ink circles for shafts and a straight line for the subterranean channel, tied with a thin red cord, while a simple wooden measuring rod is tucked under his other arm; keep the palette to off-white, maroon, deep green, light brown and dark brown, and present him from multiple angles with clear views of face, turban, garments and props in a clean, historically grounded shonen-anime style.
